messages:
rachel: Heads-up — saw a weird p99 blip on /v1/embeddings after the routing shuffle. p50/p95 steady, p99 +300ms. anyone around?
monitoring-bot: alert: endpoint=/v1/embeddings p99 exceeded baseline (380ms -> 680ms) at 11:02 UTC
sam: looks like a small sub-pop is causing the tail. we really lack provenance on the percentile in the UI.
anya: agreed. UX idea: add a "percentile context" hover that shows sample_count, top-3 contributing tags (origin, kv_cache_hit, pool), and a confidence badge (high/low).
luis: +1 from stats side. we can compute top contributors by scanning the t-digest/histogram for the buckets that push the quantile. cheap if we limit the scan to top N tags. also we could expose a p99_confidence interval via bootstrap or analytic approx.
mike: implementation sketch: backend endpoint `/internal/percentile/context?endpoint=/v1/embeddings&quantile=0.99` returns sample_count, contributors, and a simple ci. console shows hover and small inline hint like "p99 (low confidence)".
sam: important: do NOT change the raw percentile calc — just annotate. For alerts, add a gating rule: if sample_count < 0.5% of endpoint traffic OR total_samples < 100 in window, mark as low-sample and either suppress full incident or show a lower-severity notification.
anya: filing a short console ticket CONS-501 for the hover + confidence badge; add alert tweak as follow-up in same ticket. cc @sam for alerting.
mike: I'll spin up a quick mock returning fake data so UX can iterate. PR will include schema: sample_count, contributors=[{"tag":"origin=routeX","impact_ms":"+220"}], p99_ci_low, p99_ci_high.
luis: small note: contributor impact_ms should be computed as difference between global p99 and p99 without that tag's samples; approximate is fine.
rachel: that will help triage massively. Also suggest showing a tiny sparklines pane split by hit/miss for kv_cache.
sam: agree. short-term: opt-in flag in console to enable provenance hover. long-term: default-on once we validate perf.
monitoring-bot: created task CONS-501 and incident stub INC-2026-099 for tracking
mike: prototyping now, will push a demo by EOD.
anya: assigning owners: mike backend, luis stats, sam alerting, rachel UX. we'll reconvene after demo. thanks team.
